in_chain_replicate.role: the within-chain null the delta is read at -- COMP-1's in-chain A/A, shared with G5 under owner decision 160

boundary: A development read on a TRAIN construction fold (owner decisions 28 and 86); never a test claim, never a generalisation claim, and it admits nothing beyond the no-harm entry it is registered for. No utterance text, transcript, gold label or model output is printed or persisted.
decision_rule: NO-HARM ADMITTED (owner decision 127): against the IN-CHAIN A/A arm flown in the same chain, the paired CI95 lower bound of the intent-accuracy delta (primary, decision 133) is not below -0.9943 pp AND the paired CI95 lower bound of the official pooled SLU-F1 delta (the guard) is not below -1.2485 pp -- each metric read at its own Fold A own-null half-width (PLAN vs PLANr, docs/readiness/2026-09-26-slurp-stage3-measurement-instrument-v1.md section 2d). HARMFUL: a measured loss on either metric (CI95 upper bound below zero, decision 25). NEUTRAL-BY-WIDTH IS THE ADMISSION: a CI that includes zero and clears the margin is exactly the reading a base item requires (decision 127). The item is NEVER reported as a gain, whatever the point estimate; two base items are never assumed to add, and the cumulative check is the next composed round (decision 138). Every verdict carries the per-scenario table in both weightings, the frontier row (decision 75), the measured Reviewer prompt-token delta per contact and per row, the Reviewer contact rate, and a model-free count of Reviewer responses that narrate a tool call or a tool result on each arm (the downstream failure docs/results/2026-09-26-system-summary001-fidelity-and-feedback-diagnostic.md recorded).
steps: 1. Refuse unless BOTH the G5 arm and the shared in-chain A/A (SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-COMP1-AA-FOLD-A-V1, owner decision 160) carry a COMPLETE sealed manifest at 1,080 rows with the committed roster's ids, each with one successful complete official TRAIN score, and they flew in the SAME batch-driver chain on the same resident session; the arm's config hash is this package's (the repaired instruction) and the A/A's is COMP-1's package's (the old instruction, the locked plan's own request bytes, proven byte-identical to G5's superseded A/A in docs/readiness/2026-09-27-slurp-stage3-comp-1-fold-a-v1/shared-aa-proof-v1.json).

2. Structural stage: on both arms, 0 tool schemas and 0 tool calls on every contact; the Reviewer contact rate per row; the Reviewer prompt tokens per contact from the sealed COST records, whose arm-minus-A/A difference must sit at the measured -51 (a boundary token of tolerance); and a model-free count of Reviewer responses on each arm whose text narrates a tool call or a tool result (counts only, no text persisted).

3. Score once per arm over the complete manifest with the dataset's standard scorer (slurp-slu-official-train through core.scoring_batch, never sharded); take per row scenario_action_exact and the per-row SLU-F1 contributions.

4. Paired row bootstrap (10,000 draws, seed 20260927) of the arm minus in-chain A/A delta on intent accuracy and on official pooled SLU-F1; report the point estimate and CI95 of each; report the same paired delta against the sealed PLAN comparator BESIDE it, never instead of it.

5. Apply the no-harm rule: ADMITTED iff the intent lower bound >= -0.9943 and the SLU lower bound >= -1.2485; HARMFUL iff either upper bound < 0 (decision 25); otherwise NOT ADMITTED (width). Never write 'gain' or 'no gain'.

6. Report beside every number: the per-scenario table in the natural-mixture and equal-stratum weightings; the frontier row (decision 75); the measured token delta per Reviewer contact and per row; the tool-narration counts of step 2; and the A/A's own delta against the sealed comparator as the instrument's reading.
7. Hand the admitted pin (comp2-pin-v1.json) to COMP-2 for the cumulative check (decision 138); an unadmitted pin is withdrawn from COMP-2 with the tool-narration counts as the first root-cause lead.
title: Cell G5 -- the standard paired roster read on intent + SLU against the sealed PLAN arm, at the in-chain A/A null flown beside it, under the no-harm rule
